docs.summary: A baked navmesh as a standalone `.navmesh` asset: the compressed layers plus everything needed to reinstantiate a [`DtNavMesh`](#api~Prowl.Recast.Detour.DtNavMesh) at load time. Built by [`NavMeshBuilder`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshBuilder) and registered through [`AddNavMeshData`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshWorld~AddNavMeshData). Independent of any scene, so a procedural world can build one at runtime.

Current asset format version. Bump when the tile byte format or the shape of the serialized settings changes, so stale assets fail with a clear message instead of loading wrong. Version 2 split [`Settings`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.RagdollBuilder.Settings) into an agent envelope and overrides.
Oldest format version this engine still reads. Anything older must be rebaked.
The format version this asset was serialized with.
The settings this navmesh was built with (a snapshot — later inspector edits to a surface do not retroactively change it). Rebuilds reuse these for consistency.
World-space bounds of the baked geometry.
World-space bounds of the baked geometry.
Origin of the tile grid (world space). Tile (x, z) starts at Origin + (x * TileWorldSize, 0, z * TileWorldSize).
Side length of one tile in world units.

Navmesh tile slots this asset was baked for. A slot holds one VERTICAL LAYER, not one grid tile, so this is the grid scaled by the layers a tile is expected to stack. `ResolveCapacity` is what instantiation actually uses.

Compressed voxelization layers, one or more per tile. Each blob is self-describing (tile coordinates and layer index live in its header); a tile contributes several vertical layers where floors overlap. The TileCache contours these into Detour tiles, which is what lets an obstacle re-carve a tile without re-voxelizing the world.

A copy for one consumer's private use, so runtime tile and link rewrites do not land on an asset every other consumer of the same `.navmesh` is reading. The blobs are shared rather than duplicated: a rebuild replaces entries in these lists and never edits one in place, so the copy costs two lists rather than the megabytes they point at.

Off-mesh links. Tiles are rebuilt from geometry-only layers whenever an obstacle carves or a region regenerates — anything baked into them is regenerated away — so links live here and are re-injected on every tile build. Kept in step with the live [`NavMeshLink`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshLink)s by [`RebuildLinkTiles`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshSurface~RebuildLinkTiles).
True when there is at least one layer to instantiate.

Triangulate this baked navmesh without registering it — for editor gizmos and tooling that need to visualize an asset the scene isn't running. Instantiates a throwaway navmesh, so cache the result rather than calling it per frame.

Instantiate a TileCache (and its owned navmesh) from the compressed layers, seeded synchronously so the mesh is queryable immediately. Obstacles added later rebuild affected tiles incrementally via `DtTileCache.Update`.

params.maxObstacles: Obstacle capacity the cache is created with.
